html:
What is beautiful about traveling to Sapa during Tet? This is a question that many people are interested in. To choose for yourself the most enjoyable trip to the foggy city or to enjoy hunting clouds and snow, you should visit Sapa during Tet to experience the most interesting things.

Sapa is a beautiful destination. Although each season Sapa brings its own beauty, but traveling to Sapa during Tet, visitors will be immersed in a more poetic scene, because of the clouds and white snowflakes covering the roads, visitors will be satisfied with the winter beauty of Sapa.

Destinations not to be missed when traveling to Sapa during Tet

Kim Son Bao Thang Pagoda

A sacred place that many tourists visit during Tet or early spring, to offer incense to pray for peace, a healthy and peaceful new year, the pagoda is located on the top of Fansipan, in winter, this place is covered with white snow, you will think you are in Korea, not in Sapa, Kim Son Bao Thang Pagoda brings visitors a pure beauty.

If you travel to Sapa during Tet, you should definitely visit Kim Son Bao Thang Pagoda, to feel the pure beauty that this place brings to visitors, the pagoda has its own design exuding purity, the pagoda stands out in the middle of the green forest.

When visiting Kim Son Bao Thang Pagoda, right in front of the pagoda you will see the Buddha altar, behind is the place to worship the Saint, so many tourists still call it the place to worship the Saint, right in the center of the pagoda is a majestic Buddha statue, coming here visitors feel peaceful, and admire the scenery at the Buddha’s door.

Trekking the villages during Tet

Going on a Sapa tour for Tet, visitors should visit the villages, and experience the culture of the ethnic minorities in the Northwest highlands to celebrate Tet, blending with the blue sky in the middle of the majestic mountains and forests will bring visitors a feeling of excitement.

Sapa Cloud Hunting

Every year, at the end of the year, visitors from all over the world come here to hunt clouds, and immerse themselves in the scenery of blooming flowers, especially when traveling to Sapa on cold days, visitors will be satisfied to see the white snow and play with the snow.

Many young people are excited to be immersed in the sea of ​​clouds, from the view of the hotel or cafes, visitors can admire the floating scene in the early morning mist, with clouds covering the hillsides, when noon comes, the clouds gradually dissipate, revealing rows of green trees, a peaceful and poetic scene.

The cloud hunting spot chosen by many tourists when traveling to Sapa is Fansipan peak, from above visitors can see the scenery of Sapa town, Ham Rong mountain hidden in the misty fog, you just need to spend time on a 3-day, 2-night Sapa tour to be satisfied with cloud hunting.

Experience life with the local people, you can choose to stay at a local house or homestay to experience the customs and daily life of the people here, especially the way they prepare the traditional New Year’s tray, which will make visitors remember forever.

When staying with the locals, you will feel the warm affection that the highland people have for visitors, the friendliness and hospitality and enjoy delicious dishes prepared by the locals.

Watch the sunrise and sunset at Sapa Heaven Gate.

Sapa is a place with a magical scene, when the sunset falls, covering the whole mountain town, creating a picture of the mountain town, early in the morning, Sapa seems to put on a new coat because of the dense fog, when the fog gradually clears to reveal a beautiful scene, if you are a nature lover who wants to get away from the dust, come to Sapa to admire the scenery and blend in with the nature of the land and sky in the Northwest mountains.

O Quy Ho Pass

Conquering the top of O Quy Ho Pass, visitors will feel excited, when the cool weather in Sapa during Tet is very suitable for visitors to conquer the pass, this is one of the dangerous passes and has a beautiful view, a destination sought after by backpackers when traveling to the Northwest.

It can be said that Sapa has quite beautiful weather in winter, which will bring visitors a memorable adventure when conquering the pass or immersing themselves in the sea of ​​clouds, or experiencing the life of the people here, will bring you the most perfect Tet holiday.

Above are the experiences of traveling to Sapa during Tet, hopefully it will help your trip, if you are a person who loves to admire the natural scenery away from the hustle and bustle of the city, Sapa is the destination for you. Especially during Tet holiday, Sapa not only has a sea of ​​clouds but also white snow covering the hillsides or the houses are all covered in white.
